mapper.select: SELECT c.class_code AS classCode, c.name AS name, c.address AS address, c.address2 AS address2, c.price AS price FROM class c JOIN class_repeat_rule crr ON c.class_code = crr.class_code JOIN schedule s ON s.repeat_rule_code = crr.repeat_rule_code WHERE s.schedule_code = #{scheduleCode}

select class_date as classDate, start_time as startTime, end_time as endTime, remaining_people as remainingPeople FROM class c JOIN class_repeat_rule crr ON c.class_code = crr.class_code JOIN schedule s ON s.repeat_rule_code = crr.repeat_rule_code WHERE s.schedule_code = #{scheduleCode}

select cate.name as categoryName from category cate join class c on c.category_code = cate.category_code JOIN class_repeat_rule crr ON c.class_code = crr.class_code JOIN schedule s ON s.repeat_rule_code = crr.repeat_rule_code WHERE s.schedule_code = #{scheduleCode}
